keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Groningen 1, Sparta Rotterdam 0. Jacob Ondrejka (Groningen) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Brynjólfur Willumsson.
Tika de Jonge (Groningen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Mitchell van Bergen (Sparta Rotterdam).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Sparta Rotterdam).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Groningen 1, Sparta Rotterdam 1. Cedric Hatenboer (Sparta Rotterdam) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Marvin Young with a through ball.
Goal! Groningen 1, Sparta Rotterdam 2. Milan Zonneveld (Sparta Rotterdam) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Groningen 2, Sparta Rotterdam 2. Thom van Bergen (Groningen) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Hans Hateboer with a through ball.
Bruno Martins Indi (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Groningen 2, Sparta Rotterdam 2.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Teo Quintero replaces Nick Verschuren.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Robin van Cruijsen replaces Jens Toornstra because of an injury.
Lushendry Martes (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Andrej Kostic replaces Milan Zonneveld.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Shunsuke Mito replaces Isaac Babadi.
Cedric Hatenboer (Sparta Rotterdam) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Groningen. Tygo Land replaces Thom van Bergen.
Substitution, Groningen. Jismerai Dillema replaces Brynjólfur Willumsson.
Substitution, Groningen. Nils Eggens replaces Jacob Ondrejka.
Substitution, Groningen. Wouter Prins replaces Jorg Schreuders.
Goal! Groningen 2, Sparta Rotterdam 3. Andrej Kostic (Sparta Rotterdam) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Groningen. Oskar Zawada replaces Marco Rente.
Substitution, Sparta Rotterdam. Giannino Vianello replaces Mitchell van Bergen.
Second Half ends, Groningen 2, Sparta Rotterdam 3.
